parts.label: a

parts.label: b
parts.text: (b) Hydrogen gas can be made from petroleum by a two-step procedure. step 1 Petroleum is separated into diﬀerent components. step 2 Large molecules obtained in step 1 are converted into smaller molecules including hydrogen gas.

parts.label: c
parts.text: (c) Organic compounds contain hydrogen atoms. Calculate the number of hydrogen atoms in 44.0 g of the ester methyl propanoate, CH 3 CH 2 COOCH 3 . One mole of CH 3 CH 2 COOCH 3 contains 6.02 × 10 23 molecules. Give your answer in standard form. number of hydrogen atoms = .................................................. [4]

ms.label: 5(c)
ms.text:
M1 Mr of CH3CH2COOCH3 = 88
M2 mol of CH3CH2COOCH3 = 44 / 88 = 0.5
M3 mol of H = 0.5 × 8 = 4.0
M4 no of H atoms = 4.0 × 6.02 × 10
